title: Moreish Puff Candy Drops Watermelon Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: This delicious flavour from Moreish Puff’s Candy Drops nic salt range delivers the fresh, mellow sweetness of Watermelon with a sour kick of Cherry candy for an irresistible all-day vape. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
